title: Houthis Vow to Continue Targeting Saudi Aramco Facilities
detail: Yemen's Houthis publicly vowed to continue targeting Saudi Aramco facilities, signaling intent to sustain pressure on Saudi energy infrastructure. The declaration follows a pattern of escalating strikes on Saudi strategic and economic targets and underscores Houthi resolve to maintain their offensive campaign against Saudi Arabia's energy sector.
